content: Refunds are reviewed within 3 to 5 business days after the claim is verified. Duplicate charges are reversed after account review and confirmation of the payment history.
Invoices can be disputed if the charge amount does not match the order confirmation or if the product was damaged on arrival.
Tracking updates may lag by 24 to 48 hours during carrier delays. Customers should use the live tracking link in the order portal for the latest information.
Late deliveries are monitored automatically and can be rescheduled if the carrier marks the parcel as delayed or lost.
App crashes are commonly caused by outdated mobile versions. Customers should update to the latest app version and then retry their export or login flow.
Export failures are logged and usually resolved in the next patch release. If the issue persists, we recommend clearing the app cache and retrying.
Too many failed login attempts trigger a temporary lockout as a security measure. Password resets are required if a session is blocked after repeated failed sign-ins.
Bulk CSV export requests are reviewed in the product roadmap process. High-volume users can request advanced exports through the support team.
Refund requests for damaged items are matched against delivery proof and item condition reports before approval.
Packages with mismatched addresses are held at the carrier facility until the customer confirms the correct delivery details.
